The '''Mission to Christophsis''' took place on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Prelude==
When Christophsis was overrun by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces, a group of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] was sent to the planet to retrieve lost data before the Separatists could get their hands on them. The clones were to locate and retrieve five [[Datacard/Legends|datapacks]].

==The mission==
During the mission, they encountered and eliminated several [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. They eventually recovered the databacks.

==Behind the scenes==
The mission constitutes the first level of the online game ''[[LiveFire|Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Live Fire]]'' which is part of the advertising campaign pertaining to the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Clone Wars'' film]]. As of now it is not known whether it is actually a part of the Battle of Christophsis or a separate mission.
